name: spotify_player
description: Fetch the currently playing track or podcast episode, list the user's playlists, and get a playlist's details and tracks from Spotify.

action.description: Action to perform: 'current_track' (what is playing now), 'playlists' (the user's playlists) or 'playlist' (one playlist's details and tracks)

playlist_id.description: Playlist ID, spotify:playlist: URI or open.spotify.com URL. Required when action is 'playlist'.

limit.description: Number of playlists ('playlists') or playlist tracks ('playlist') to return

offset.description: Index of the first playlist or playlist track to return, for paging through results

include_items.description: For 'playlist': also fetch the playlist's tracks. Spotify only returns tracks for the user's own playlists.

raw.description: Return Spotify's full JSON response instead of a compact summary
